How we collect, use, and protect your data

GuardSoul is designed with privacy as the foundation. All sensitive content detection (such as NSFW scanning) happens on your device. We do not upload screenshots, app usage details, or browsing history to any server unless you explicitly enable cloud sync and sign in to a Google or email account.

The NSFW scanner uses a TensorFlow Lite model that runs locally on your Android device. Screenshots never leave your phone. Blocklists, schedules, and statistics stay in encrypted local storage unless you opt-in to cloud sync.

If you enable cloud backup, your blocklists and non-sensitive settings are synced to Google Firebase (Firestore) using your account. You can disable cloud sync at any time from the Account screen, and your cloud data will be deleted within 30 days.

Subscription payments are processed by Google Play. We receive a receipt token from Google and a derived entitlement (Free/Pro/Premium). We never see your credit card number or Google account password.

We use Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics to improve stability. Crash reports are stripped of any personal data (emails, phone numbers, package names) before being sent. Analytics and crash reporting are turned off by default in the European Union and United Kingdom; you can change this at any time from Settings.
For privacy questions or data deletion requests, contact us at privacy@guardsoul.app. We respond within 30 days.
The agreement that governs your use of GuardSoul

By installing or using GuardSoul, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please uninstall the app. GuardSoul is a personal digital wellbeing tool and is not intended to control or monitor devices you do not own.

Pro and Premium plans are billed monthly or annually through Google Play. Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in Google Play â†’ Subscriptions. Refunds are handled by Google per their refund policy.

New subscribers may be eligible for a free trial period as offered by Google Play. If you do not cancel before the trial ends, you will be charged the listed subscription price. Trial availability and duration are determined by Google and may vary by region.
You agree not to use GuardSoul to monitor or control devices belonging to other people without their explicit consent, or to circumvent security features of other applications.

GuardSoul is provided \"as is\" without warranties of any kind. We do our best to make the blocking reliable, but no app blocker is 100% tamper-proof on a rooted or developer-mode device. The NSFW scanner uses statistical models that may produce false positives or false negatives.
We may update these terms from time to time. Material changes will be announced through an in-app notice. Continued use of GuardSoul after a change constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
